protocol.baseline: One shared warmup per arm after a 1,500-row fixture with a distinct 24-character marker
protocol.arms: Counterbalanced control without intermediate requests versus keeper at the default 3-minute interval
protocol.concurrency: Runs for the same batch ran at the same time on one machine and one account per host
protocol.batches: Claude/Grok 5m come from batch a, stopped after an unrelated ~/.claude/settings.json edit failed the config check. Claude/Grok 10m–2h come from batch b, where each host checked only its own config files. A ~/.codex/config.toml reasoning-effort edit invalidated Codex in batch b, so all six Codex idle times come from batch c
protocol.validation: Marker recall, completed maintenance, cadence and monotonic idle, no pause/gap, unchanged runtime/config fingerprint
protocol.estimate: CLI reported dollar values are not subscription invoices or isolated quota usage; Codex does not report dollars
protocol.sample: Two pairs per host and idle time; descriptive only; batches were rerun only after a config edit invalidated them, never to replace a measured result
